rules.statement: In the absence of acknowledgment by Andiris Rajapakse or his successors, the Crown Grant did not confer any rights on the grantees and shares in the land should be allotted based on Don Andiris being the sole owner.
rules.supporting_quote: "The nature of that possession could not be altered by the bare execution of the grant unaccompanied by the acknowledgment by Andiris Rajapakse or any of his successors of any right of co-ownership in the representatives in interest of Don Tiyadoris.'"
